listing.partOfThreadTitle: [0.98a] [WIP] Derelict Start, Remnant Start, Omega Start & Threat Start

description:
Three mods that add Derelict custom start, Remnant custom start, Omega custom start & Threat custom start and put the player under their commission
Allow player interaction with Domain Mothership, Remnant Station, Coronal Hypershunt or Threat fleet with Fabricator Unit as semi-working station
Also allow player to pilot automated ships and have fleetwide immunity to solar corona and similar hazards
By default Derelict, Remnant, Omega & Threat are hostile to most factions but there's a LunaLib settings to turn them peaceful to all but Pirates and Pathers
Inspired from the mod Crabshack's Remnant custom start

aiDescription: Adds a custom start where the player is commissioned under an Omega faction. Allows interaction with a Coronal Hypershunt as a semi-working station and piloting of automated ships. Grants fleetwide immunity to solar corona and similar hazards.

gallery.aiCaption: A game menu showing the 'John Derelict' faction option with a portrait of an astronaut.
A sector configuration screen displaying starting options and fleet assets for the Adrift faction.
A background selection menu listing options like 'Unknown', 'AI Fleet Commander', and 'Associates'.
An informational popup describing the 'Domain-era Mothership' with an image of a large space station.
A mission briefing screen featuring a large Exploratorium Mothership and text about its services.
A command interface with a red-tinted image of debris and a list of options including 'Evaluate available cargo'.
A 'Mothership Supply' inventory screen showing various items and the faction's star emblem.
A ship design selection menu listing numerous capital ships like 'Nemesis class' and 'Arsenal class' with their costs.
A storage network access screen displaying the faction emblem and options to manage commodities or ships.
A 'Mothership Global Storage' interface showing resource counts and item icons against a blue nebula background.
